name: get_patient_conditions
description: Get a patient's medical conditions, diagnoses, and chronic diseases from their EHR. Returns conditions with clinical status, onset dates, and severity.

name: get_patient_medications
description: Get a patient's current active medications from their EHR. Returns medication names, dosage instructions, and prescription dates.

name: get_patient_observations
description: Get a patient's clinical observations including lab results and vital signs. Optionally filter by category (e.g., 'vital-signs', 'laboratory', 'imaging').

name: get_patient_allergies
description: Get a patient's documented allergies and intolerances. Returns allergen substances, criticality levels, and reaction types.

name: get_patient_appointments
description: Get a patient's scheduled appointments. Returns appointment dates, times, status, and descriptions.

name: advanced_patient_search
description: Search for patients using advanced FHIR search parameters including demographics, age categories (pediatric, adolescent, adult, geriatric), location filters, and resource includes. Supports FHIR modifiers and chaining.

search_params.description: FHIR search parameters as key-value pairs. Examples: {'name': 'Smith', 'gender': 'female', 'age_category': 'geriatric', 'city': 'Seattle', 'state': 'WA'}. Age categories: pediatric (0-12), adolescent (13-17), adult (18-64), geriatric (65+).

include_params.description: Optional: FHIR _include parameters to include related resources (e.g., ['Patient:general-practitioner'])

revinclude_params.description: Optional: FHIR _revinclude parameters to include reverse references (e.g., ['Observation:patient'])

name: get_patient_everything
description: Get a comprehensive patient record using the FHIR $patient-everything operation. Returns all resources related to a patient including conditions, medications, observations, procedures, encounters, and more. Optionally filter by date range.

start_date.description: Optional: Start date for filtering resources (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

end_date.description: Optional: End date for filtering resources (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

name: create_fhir_resource
description: Create (persist) a new FHIR resource on the patient's HealthLake record. Use this to save a prior-authorization decision as a FHIR ClaimResponse, or to create a Task. CREATE-ONLY — it cannot update or delete existing resources. Provide the FHIR resourceType and the complete resource as a JSON object.

resource_type.description: FHIR resource type to create, e.g. 'ClaimResponse' or 'Task'

resource_data.description: The complete FHIR resource as a JSON object. The resourceType field is set automatically to match resource_type.
